test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the given group of words.

The action or offence of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things
solution: The correct answer is- **"Blasphemy"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the given options, **"Blasphemy"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The word **'Blasphemy'** refers to something said or done that displays extreme disdain for God, something sacred, or both. (भगवान या पवित्र चीज़ों के बारे में अपवित्रतापूर्वक बोलना) • **Example: **When Jake made a joke in church, his mother accused him of** blasphemy.** • **​**Thus, ***option 3)*** is the correct alternative. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too. • **Contamination:** to make impure or unfit for use by adding something harmful or unpleasant. (किसी हानिकारक चीज़ को मिलाकर उपयोग के लिए अयोग्य बनान) • **Example: **The **contamination** of river water is mainly caused by human activities. • **Irreverence: **not treating official, important, or holy things with the appropriate respect. (अनादर भाव) • **Example: **He was fired for treating classical music with** irreverence**. • **Renunciation: **The formal declaration that one no longer controls, backs, supports, holds dear, or is associated with something. (किसी वस्‍तु या विश्‍वास को औपचारिक रूप से त्‍याग देना; परित्‍याग) • **Example: **The talks were dependent on a*** renunciation*** of terrorism. 2f9:T9a5, The correct answer is-** "Failed".**
